from utils.melody_extractor import MelodyExtractor
from utils.guitar_generator import GuitarGenerator
from utils.audio_processor import AudioProcessor

melody_extractor = None
guitar_generator = None
audio_processor = AudioProcessor()


def load_models():
    global melody_extractor, guitar_generator
    if melody_extractor is None:
        print("🎸 Loading models...")
        melody_extractor = MelodyExtractor()
        guitar_generator = GuitarGenerator()
        print("✅ All models loaded!")


@spaces.GPU
def generate_guitar_cover(audio_file, chords: str, style: str, progress=gr.Progress()):
    if audio_file is None:
        raise gr.Error("Please upload a song first!")

    try:
        load_models()

        progress(0.1, desc="🎵 Extracting melody from song...")
        vocals_path = melody_extractor.extract_vocals(audio_file)

        song_info = audio_processor.get_audio_info(audio_file)
        progress(0.2, desc=f"✅ Melody extracted ({song_info['duration_formatted']})")

        def musicgen_progress(pct, msg):
            progress(0.2 + pct * 0.7, desc=f"🎸 {msg}")

        progress(0.3, desc="🎸 Generating acoustic guitar cover...")
        guitar_path = guitar_generator.generate_full_cover(
            melody_path=vocals_path,
            chords=chords.strip() if chords else "",
            style=style,
            progress_callback=musicgen_progress,
        )

        progress(0.95, desc="🔊 Normalizing audio...")
        guitar_path = audio_processor.normalize_audio(guitar_path)
